title: Release window orchestration and scope-lock matrix for API / Console / Runtime
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Establish a deterministic orchestration plan and scope-lock matrix that governs milestone windows for the API, Console, and Runtime release train. The artifact will be used by PM, Eng, and Design to decide what lands in the next ship window, which changes must be deferred, and the automated signals that trigger a cut or extend a window (e.g., critical bug discovery, performance regressions, security issues). This ticket covers the playbook, owner matrix, cut criteria thresholds, and release notes coordination checklist.
goals: Define a repeatable scope-lock matrix with three tiers (feature freeze, regression-only, emergency fixes) and explicit owners for each tier.
Create milestone windows and a calendar of gating events for API, Console, Runtime with clear handoff moments between PM / Eng / Design.
Publish a release-note coordination workflow and template so that product and docs can ship coherent notes across three surfaces.

2026-04-12: Internal RC and release notes draft complete
scope_lock_rules: Tier A - Feature Freeze: New feature PRs are blocked after 'feature freeze' date; exceptions require PM + Eng lead + Design approval.
Tier B - Regression-Only: Post-feature-freeze only bug fixes that do not change public API contract or major UX flows; requires SLO/telemetry signoff.
Tier C - Emergency Patch: Security fixes and critical reliability patches allowed anytime with expedited review and CI gating.
All exceptions must be logged with decision rationale and linked PR/issue in the release tracker.
cut_criteria: Blocking bug: Any SEV1 (prod outage or data loss) discovered within 72 hours of release -> hold and escalate.
Performance: Runtime P95 latency increase > 10% versus baseline for high-traffic endpoints -> requires rollback or mitigation plan.
Regression: >1% user-facing error-rate increase on Console during RC window -> unblock only after root-cause fix and validation.
Security: Any confirmed high/critical CVE affecting deployed binaries -> immediate hold and emergency release path.
Observability: Missing or failing tracing/metrics for new surface -> delay until telemetry backfills and smoke tests pass.
stakeholders: Security Team (on call) - review for security_review_required items
rollout_strategy: Canary -> 5% (24h) -> 25% (48h) -> 100% (72h) with automated health checks at each step.
Automatic rollback on canary if error-rate > 0.5% absolute increase or P95 latency > 15%.
Model variants: API will route first to low-cost model variant for 10% of traffic for telemetry prior to full runtime variant switch.
Dedicated customers: notify account engineering 7 days in advance and provide opt-in window for new model variants.
communication_plan: Weekly sync (Tuesdays, 30m) for cross-functional owners during the cycle - calendar invite created by PM.
Release channel #release-train in Slack: daily stand-up posts during cut week and immediate incident notifications.
Ship announcement draft in Confluence + marketing notify checklist 48h before public release.
Automated status page updates for customers in case of hold or rollback.
release_notes_coordination: Owners: Priya Menon (primary notes author), Aisha Patel (product review), Marco Nguyen (technical accuracy)
Template: use /confluence/redwood/release-notes-template, sections for API breaking changes, console UX notes, runtime impact, known issues.
Deadlines: first draft by 2026-04-08, internal review complete by 2026-04-11, localization handoff by 2026-04-12.
Changelog tagging: ensure all PRs include 'changelog: yes' label where appropriate and a 1-line user-facing summary in PR body.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Last-minute performance regressions on Runtime. Mitigation: enforce perf bench for PRs touching kernel selection and require perf-approved label.
Risk: Docs misalignment across Console and API references. Mitigation: lock docs owner early; run doc-diff review against staged console build.
Risk: Dedicated customers experience unexpected capacity changes. Mitigation: coordinate with Dedicated sales + infra to provide reserved windows and run preflight tests.
decisions: Adopt three-tier scope lock (Feature Freeze / Regression-Only / Emergency Patch) - approved 2026-03-05 by PM/Eng/Design.
Adopt automated metric checks for cut criteria using Pulseboard alerts (latency, error-rate, traces) - approved 2026-03-08.
Release notes will be single canonical Confluence doc and exported to support and marketing for consistency.
